name: fs.find
description: Walks a directory tree and returns typed metadata records for entries matching name globs, kinds, depth, size and time bounds, stopping at an entry budget so deep trees stay bounded and cancellable.

path.description: Tree root to walk; relative paths resolve from the program working directory.

names.description: Keep entries whose file name matches any glob; * and ? stay within one name, and a leading dot opts hidden names in.

kinds.description: Keep only these entry kinds: file, directory, symlink, fifo, socket or other.

include_hidden.description: Consider names starting with a dot; hidden names are skipped by default.

min_depth.description: Smallest depth below the root to report, where the root itself is depth zero.

max_depth.description: Deepest depth below the root to report or descend into; at most 256.

newer_than.description: Keep entries modified strictly after this epoch millisecond timestamp.

older_than.description: Keep entries modified strictly before this epoch millisecond timestamp.

min_size.description: Keep entries with at least this many bytes.

max_size.description: Keep entries with at most this many bytes.

follow_symlinks.description: Report link target metadata in records; traversal still never descends through symlinked directories. Defaults to false.

limit.description: Stop after this many matches; reaching the result cap without a smaller limit fails instead of silently dropping matches.

examples.program: run fs.find with path "." and names ["catalog-example-no-match-494-*"] as matches
